summary: Iter 17 — narration polish (paused_summary_narration + completion_narration) verified end-to-end. New pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_storyline_summaries.py: 10 passed, 1 skipped (single-beat short-circuit). Spawn-from-action contract holds: when current_storyline_id is supplied and the action is off-hook, response.paused_summary_narration is a 1-3 sentence Mercer-style cue citing the paused storyline title and (when present) the obligation NPC with comma-roles stripped (verified via regex match against the template's `— {name} will be waiting` slot — no commas leak through the n.split(',')[0] cleaner). When spawned=false (on-hook or no current storyline), the paused_summary_narration is null/absent so the frontend skips the injection. Resolve endpoint always returns completion_narration key (null on non-completing, string on completing — direct unit test on _build_completion_narration confirms it prefers storyline.epilogue, then falls back to a title + last-beat-target template). Creative endpoint also returns the key. Regression suites all pass: test_offhook_spawn.py 14/14, test_resume_attempt.py 6/6, test_mission_phase_badge.py 6/6. Frontend wiring verified by inspection at the line numbers cited in the review request: ActiveInvestigationPanel.jsx L213+L345 pass data.completion_narration as the 3rd arg to onComplete; L267-273 inject paused_summary_narration via onCreativeNarration BEFORE the first-beat description (L277-282); AdventureLogWithDM.jsx L1762-1793 accepts the 3rd arg, pushes a DM beat with source='storyline-complete' + isCinematic=true into messages BEFORE opening the reward modal. Cinematic violet gradient styling (L1817-1818) applies because it keys off isCinematic flag. Frontend home loads with 0 errors.

ui_bugs.issue: There is no case for `source === 'storyline-complete'` in the label-selector switch — a completed-storyline beat with isCinematic=true will fall through to the cinematic default label '🎭 The Adventure Begins' (designed for the campaign-intro world-brief). Styling/gradient is correct; only the title COPY is wrong. Recommend adding a branch like `: entry.source === 'storyline-complete' ? `🎬 Investigation Closes${entry.meta?.storylineTitle ? ' — ' + entry.meta.storylineTitle : ''}`` before the final isCinematic fallback.

action_items: Optional: add a `storyline-complete` case to the AdventureLogWithDM source-label switch (L1834-1846) so the label reads e.g. '🎬 Investigation Closes — {title}' instead of the default '🎭 The Adventure Begins'. The cinematic styling itself is correct.

Optional: align _build_completion_narration return shape — currently when epilogue is present the helper returns it as-is (no 'Investigation closed:' prefix despite the docstring comment at L150-151). Either drop the misleading comment OR add the prefix. Functionally fine either way.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/storylines.py _build_completion_narration (L142-167): correct precedence (epilogue → title+target → bare title fallback). Note: docstring/comment at L150-151 promises an 'Investigation closed:' prefix which is NOT actually applied to the epilogue branch (returns f'{epilogue}' verbatim). Minor doc/code drift; functional behavior matches the spec ('prefers storyline.epilogue').

routers/storylines.py spawn-from-action (L438-455): clean composition — comma-roles stripped via n.split(',')[0].strip(); single vs. multi-NPC branches handled distinctly with 'and the others' shaping; storyline title is lower-cased so the sentence flows. paused_summary_narration is only set inside the `if current_storyline and current_storyline.get('status') == 'active'` block (L415) — so when no current storyline is supplied OR the supplied storyline is already paused/completed, the field stays None (good — matches the contract that the frontend skips injection).

routers/storylines.py resolve + creative endpoints (L1437, L1644): both already wire `completion_narration: _build_completion_narration(storyline) if completed else None` — the key is ALWAYS present, which is exactly the documented contract for the frontend to read safely without optional-chaining.

Frontend AdventureLogWithDM.jsx onComplete (L1762-1793): correctly orders log insertion BEFORE setShowRewardModal(reward) at L1786, so the completion beat lands on screen before the modal pops. The fallback chain `completionNarration || sl?.epilogue` (L1766) keeps backward compat with pre-iter17 callsites that only pass 2 args.

Frontend ActiveInvestigationPanel.jsx callCreative (L265-285): pause-summary injection happens FIRST (L267-273), then onUpdate (L274), then the new-storyline first-beat description (L277-282) — matches the spec ordering for the Adventure Log.

Test infrastructure: test_resume_attempt.py had a stale default `DB_NAME='dnd_dm'` which mismatched backend's `dnd_ai_db` — caused 3 false failures when MONGO_URL/DB_NAME aren't exported. Fixed the default to 'dnd_ai_db' (line 32). Iter 16 likely passed only because env was sourced at the time of run.
